narrative.overview: The dark chart reads like a station display. A cool daylight frame surrounds it, and a compact ledger makes the accompanying figures easy to scan.
keyCharacteristics: Tabular readings sit in fixed positions.

rules.name: The Fixed Reading Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for quotes, axis labels, selected dates and metric values. Keep the trading date and currency next to the corresponding reading.

dos: Do keep the chart trace, selection marker and active range in the same aqua.
Do label dates and currencies at the point of reading.
donts: Don't add shadows to the data panels.
Don't communicate price direction by color alone.
